svg.title: Maternal capture during pushing: displayed FHR follows the maternal pulse
svg.desc: Six-minute synthetic strip. The displayed FHR is fetal at about 145 bpm for the first minute, then after a brief gap follows the dashed maternal pulse (about 100 bpm, rising to 135 with pushes at 1.5 and 3.5 minutes), so pushes look like accelerations. At 4 minutes the transducer is repositioned and the fetal rate of about 145 bpm is confirmed by ultrasound. No fetal trace is drawn during capture. External toco below.
svg.text: Displayed rate = maternal pulse: source wrong
